# Cash App Revenue and Usage Statistics (2026)
##### Cash App Revenue and Usage Statistics (2026) - Business of Apps
Copied to clipboard

What if you could pay people via email?

Users only had to connect a debit card and then they could pay people with an email address. It launched Android and iOS apps which simplified the process even further, and added mobile number functionality a year later.

This was the first step towards monetization, as businesses were charged 1.5 percent per transaction, while users can send money to friends for free.

Drawn from **35+** of the top **100** US finance apps.

Pulling from Jack Dorsey’s other venture [Twitter](https://www.businessofapps.com/data/twitter-statistics/), Square also launched $Cashtags, another unique identifier to pay people and businesses.

This was done so Square could get costs under control. Due to not charging for transactions, Square loses money each time a user withdraws money, so maintaining a balance improves customer contribution. In 2015, Square was losing money each time a customer signed up, but in 2017 the average customer generated $15 in revenue and that has continued to increase.

Square debuted the Cash Card in 2017, a debit card for those wary of using their phone to pay for things.

Another addition to the Cash App, and one that has rapidly accelerated revenue generation on the app, is Bitcoin trading.

It has since become the leading source of revenue for Cash App. Square made “negligible” revenue in the first few years, according to chief financial officer Amrita Ahuja, but has recorded significant revenue growth primarily because of Bitcoin.

Square’s ultimate goal appears to be to become the next generation banking app, but it has a lot of competition from established banks improving their online services and dozens of startups attempting to do the same thing as Cash App.

We have collected data and statistics on Square’s Cash App. Read on below to find out more. Want to dive deeper into mobile banking?

## Cash App Key Statistics
- Cash App made $7.2 billion revenue in 2025, a 18% increase on the previous year
- It also made $9.6 billion from Bitcoin transactions
- Card inflows to Cash App reached $83 billion by the end of 2025
- Cash App had a gross profit of $6.3 billion in 2025
- Cash App had 59 million monthly active users in 2025
- 26 million people had a Cash Card in 2025

## Cash App Revenue
Revenues generated from Cash App increased 18% in 2025 to $7.2 billion.

# Cash App And Square Are Key for Block As It Looks to AI for the Future
Cash App gross profits grew 24% year over year during the third quarter of 2025, which helped contribute to Block’s overall gross profit of $2.66 billion during the quarter, an 18% increase from a year earlier, Block chief operating officer and chief financial officer Amrita Ahuja told analysts during Block’s third-quarter earnings call late Thursday.

The payoff from these efforts is that Cash App reached 58 million monthly active users in September.

**[Cash App’s](https://www.digitaltransactions.net/block-launches-tap-to-pay-on-iphone-for-sellers-using-cash-app/)** gross profit per monthly transacting active user was $94 during the quarter, up 25% year over year.

The result was 34% growth in originations “while delivering stable risk loss and strong annualized net margins of 24%,” Ahuja said.

Square’s gross profit grew 9% year-over-year in the third quarter, while gross payment value grew 12%.

Block’s quarterly results were received positively by William Blair & Co. analyst Andrew W.

“We also highlight 25% international gross payment volume growth and note that it is now more than 20% of total.”
